+function to24Time(raw){

+}

+function parsedBlockTimes(b){
+ let start=customTokenValue(b,'START:'),end=customTokenValue(b,'END:');
+ if(start||end)return{start,end};
+ const t=String(b.time||'').replace(/—/g,'–').trim();
+ let m=t.match(/^(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)?\s*[–-]\s*(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)$/i);
+ if(m){
+   const endAp=m[4].toUpperCase();
+   const startAp=(m[2]||endAp).toUpperCase();
+   start=to24Time(m[1]+' '+startAp);end=to24Time(m[3]+' '+endAp);
+   return{start,end};
+ }
+ m=t.match(/^(\d{1,2}:\d{2})\s*(AM|PM)$/i);
+ if(m){start=to24Time(m[1]+' '+m[2]);return{start,end:''}}
+ return{start:'',end:''};
+}
